o.text: From Proto-Turkic *bi-ŕ, *bẹ-. Cognate with Old Turkic 𐰋𐰃𐰕 (b²iz /⁠biz⁠/, “we”).

From Proto-Turkic *bińŕ (“awl”).
Cognate with Bashkir беҙ (bið), Kazakh бiз (biz),
Southern Altai мис (mis),
Uzbek bigiz,
Uyghur بېگىز (bëgiz, “awl”).
Ultimately a derivation from Proto-Turkic *yüg-. Cognate with Turkish yüksek.
Borrowed from Russian кома́нда (kománda), from German Kommando.
From Turkish bombardıman, from French bombardement.
From Classical Persian بَدْرَنْگْ (badrang). By surface analysis, bəd- + rəng.
From Persian بینظیر. By surface analysis, bi- + nəzir.
